headlines.text: On this day in 2023, El Hijo del Vikingo announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance against Kenny Omega, appearing on Dynamite, rated 9.12 ? a genuine showstealer. Originally scheduled for 2021 before Omega's injuries forced its cancellation, this long-awaited dream match finally happened, with Omega picking up the win in one of the most talked-about matches of the year.

Back on this day in 2026, JetSpeed & Mistico vs. Alexander, Clon & Takeshita fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Trios Titles, appearing on Collision, rated 7.02 ? a strong outing. It was the first title opportunity of Alexander, Clon & Takeshita's career. It was the 50th time the AEW World Trios Titles had been on the line, a genuinely rare milestone for that title. Fresh off their title win, M?stico and JetSpeed turned back an immediate rematch attempt from the Don Callis Family's Alexander, El Clon and Takeshita.
It was 2024 when Fletcher & Hobbs kicked off their AEW journey as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.76.

secondaries.text: On a Saturday in 2025, back when Briscoe, Hobbs & Romero didn't ease in ? their first AEW match was the main event as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.38.
Rewind to 2023, when AEW welcomed Allin & Sting & Cassidy for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.46.

Turning the clock back to 2024: Julia Hart vs. Skye Blue vs. Kris Statlander vs. Willow Nightingale settled things in a Street Fight match, headlining the show on Rampage, rated 7.05 ? a well-worked match.
